title: Settings
description: Manage your account information and preferences.

connections.title: Sign-in methods
connections.pageDescription: Manage how you sign in to BrandHub. Link multiple methods to one account so you don't have to remember several logins.
connections.howItWorksBody: Once Google is linked, you can sign in with Google or with your email and password — both land on this same BrandHub account. Your data, role, and permissions do not change.
connections.emailPasswordDescription: Sign in with {{email}} plus your password.
connections.googleDescription: Sign in quickly with your Google account.
connections.disconnectBody: You will still be able to sign in with your remaining methods. You can reconnect at any time.
connections.emailMismatchWarning: Only use a Google account with the same current email ({{email}}) to connect.
connections.onlyMethodHint: This is your only sign-in method. Set a password before disconnecting, otherwise you will lose access to your account.

error.OAUTH_EMAIL_MISMATCH: OAuth account email does not match your current account
error.OAUTH_ALREADY_LINKED: This account is already linked to a different account

avatar.invalidType: Only JPEG, PNG, or WebP files are accepted

security.pageDescription: Change your password. You'll stay signed in on this device, but other devices will need to sign in again.
security.requirements: Password must be at least 8 characters and contain at least 1 digit.
security.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
security.passwordNeedDigit: Password must contain at least 1 digit
security.setPasswordDescription: Your account currently signs in with Google. Set a password so you can also sign in with email and password — both still land on the same account.
